The '''Kolaador Speeder Derby'''' was an annual [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] derby held on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kolaador]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The course was hundreds of kilometers long.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=crewskill|Scavenging|High-Speed Opportunities}}</ref>
